history.title: A mountain winery
history.text1: In 2003, Andeluna was born with a clear vision: to create wines that express the altitude, extreme climate and unique conditions of Gualtallary, at over 1,300 meters above sea level.
history.text2: Each vintage is a reflection of the terroir. Minimal intervention in the winery allows the fruit to speak for itself, revealing the freshness, minerality and elegance that only high mountains can offer.

winery.title: The Winery
winery.subtitle: Discover Andeluna: terroir, philosophy, architecture and team.
winery.historyText1: In 2003, the Barale family founded Andeluna with the dream of creating high mountain wines in Gualtallary.
winery.historyText2: Today, with over 20 years of experience, the winery is a benchmark in the Uco Valley.
winery.terroirText: Limestone soils, extreme altitude and mountain climate. A unique terroir that defines the identity of our wines.
winery.philosophyText: We respect the fruit. Every decision in the winery seeks to preserve the pure expression of the terroir.
winery.architectureText: The winery was designed to harness gravity and optimize the winemaking process.
winery.teamText: A passionate team that works with dedication at every stage of the process.
winery.isoText: Certifications that guarantee the quality and sustainability of our wines.

lodgePage.title: Winery Lodge
lodgePage.subtitle: 8 independent lodges where the vineyards extend to the Andes.
lodgePage.aboutText1: Inaugurated in 2023 as part of the winery's 20th anniversary, Andeluna Winery Lodge offers 8 independent lodges of 42–45 m² designed for an exclusive adults-only experience.
lodgePage.aboutText2: Each lodge features a private deck with Andes views, air conditioning, minibar and Wi-Fi. Spa and bicycles are included so you can enjoy the surroundings at your own pace.
lodgePage.ctaText: Experience the complete Andeluna Winery experience sleeping among the vineyards.

wines.title: Our Wines
wines.subtitle: Andeluna wines reflect the soil and land. Each bottle carries our geographic identity: Gualtallary, Tupungato.
wines.introText: At over 1,300 meters above sea level, each grape develops unique concentration and freshness. Our wines express the identity of Gualtallary: minerality, elegance and the unmistakable signature of the Andes.
wines.tastingText: Book a tasting experience and discover Andeluna's complete collection in the heart of the Uco Valley.
